item.tib: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus las thugs nyid gsang ba ye shes dbang sta gon dad pa'i 'jug ngog
item.coloph: ces mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi sta gon dad pa'i 'jug ngog 'di ni/ snyigs ma'i rnal 'byor kun grol grags pa gar gyi dbang phyug chen po de nyid/ tshe 'dzin mkha' 'gro dga' ba'i dbang mo dam pa'i dgyes par skyongs pa'i ngor/ mched grogs bu slob bstan sbyin rnams kyi zab mo snying gi gsang nor du/ rnam dag bkod pa'i zhing gis (gi) byang phyogs kyi tha gru chen po/ khro chen rgyal po'i mnga' ris su bsgyar ba'i sa gnad/ mu la spo yo lung gi ngo mtshar nor bu'i gling gi gtsug lag khang du brtsams pa/ gshen bstan gsal ba'i sgron me ru gyur nas/ 'gro ba smin grol zab mo'i lam la 'god par gyur cig
